declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst
declarations.header: def insertFirst (x : α) : BinaryTree α → List (BinaryTree α)

declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst_nil
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem insertFirst_nil (x : α) :
    insertFirst x .nil = [.node x .nil .nil]

declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst_node
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem insertFirst_node (x a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    insertFirst x (.node a l r) = .node x .nil (.node a l r) ::
      (insertFirst x l).map (fun l' => .node a l' r)

declarations.name: Trees.removeFirst
declarations.header: def removeFirst : BinaryTree α → BinaryTree α

declarations.name: Trees.removeFirst_node_of_ne_nil
declarations.header:
theorem removeFirst_node_of_ne_nil (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) (hl : l ≠ .nil) :
    removeFirst (.node a l r) = .node a (removeFirst l) r

declarations.name: Trees.nil_not_mem_insertFirst
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem nil_not_mem_insertFirst (x : α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    (.nil : BinaryTree α) ∉ insertFirst x t

declarations.name: Trees.inorder_of_mem_insertFirst
declarations.header:
theorem inorder_of_mem_insertFirst (x : α) {s t : BinaryTree α}
    (ht : t ∈ insertFirst x s) : inorder t = x :: inorder s

declarations.name: Trees.removeFirst_of_mem_insertFirst
declarations.header:
theorem removeFirst_of_mem_insertFirst (x : α) {s t : BinaryTree α}
    (ht : t ∈ insertFirst x s) : removeFirst t = s

declarations.name: Trees.nodup_insertFirst
declarations.header:
theorem nodup_insertFirst (x : α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    (insertFirst x t).Nodup

declarations.name: Trees.exists_insertFirst_of_inorder_cons
declarations.header:
theorem exists_insertFirst_of_inorder_cons (x : α) (xs : List α) (t : BinaryTree α)
    (ht : inorder t = x :: xs) :
    ∃ s, inorder s = xs ∧ t ∈ insertFirst x s

declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst_flatMap_nodup
declarations.header:
theorem insertFirst_flatMap_nodup (x : α) (ts : List (BinaryTree α))
    (hts : ts.Nodup) : (ts.flatMap (insertFirst x)).Nodup

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree
declarations.header: def enumTree : List α → List (BinaryTree α)

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree_nil
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem enumTree_nil : enumTree ([] : List α) = [.nil]

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree_cons
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem enumTree_cons (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    enumTree (x :: xs) = (enumTree xs).flatMap (insertFirst x)

declarations.name: Trees.mem_enumTree_iff
declarations.header:
theorem mem_enumTree_iff (xs : List α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    t ∈ enumTree xs ↔ inorder t = xs

declarations.name: Trees.set_enumTree
declarations.header:
theorem set_enumTree (xs : List α) :
    {t | t ∈ enumTree xs} = {t : BinaryTree α | inorder t = xs}

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree_nodup
declarations.header: theorem enumTree_nodup (xs : List α) : (enumTree xs).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.empty_label_enum
declarations.header: theorem empty_label_enum : enumTree ([] : List Empty) = [.nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.empty_label_nodup
declarations.header: theorem empty_label_nodup : (enumTree ([] : List Empty)).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.singleton_enum
declarations.header: theorem singleton_enum (a : α) : enumTree [a] = [.node a .nil .nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.pair_enum
declarations.header:
theorem pair_enum (a b : α) :
    enumTree [a, b] =
      [.node a .nil (.node b .nil .nil), .node b (.node a .nil .nil) .nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.repeated_shapes_nodup
declarations.header:
theorem repeated_shapes_nodup (a : α) :
    ([.node a .nil (.node a .nil .nil), .node a (.node a .nil .nil) .nil] :
      List (BinaryTree α)).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.repeated_shapes_distinct
declarations.header:
theorem repeated_shapes_distinct (a : α) :
    (.node a .nil (.node a .nil .nil) : BinaryTree α) ≠
      .node a (.node a .nil .nil) .nil

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.three_enum
declarations.header:
theorem three_enum :
    enumTree ([1, 2, 3] : List Nat) =
      [.node 1 .nil (.node 2 .nil (.node 3 .nil .nil)),
        .node 2 (.node 1 .nil .nil) (.node 3 .nil .nil),
        .node 1 .nil (.node 3 (.node 2 .nil .nil) .nil),
        .node 3 (.node 1 .nil (.node 2 .nil .nil)) .nil,
        .node 3 (.node 2 (.node 1 .nil .nil) .nil) .nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.three_nodup
declarations.header: theorem three_nodup : (enumTree ([1, 2, 3] : List Nat)).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.sample
declarations.header: def sample : BinaryTree Nat

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.sample_member
declarations.header: theorem sample_member : sample ∈ enumTree [3, 9, 7]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.sample_not_wrong_order
declarations.header: theorem sample_not_wrong_order : sample ∉ enumTree [9, 3, 7]
